findings.description: The wrapper now reuses one statistics dict across all calls and clears it on every call, so concurrent or nested invocations of the same decorated function share and overwrite each other's statistics.
findings.rationale: Trigger: two threads (or a recursive call) invoke the same decorated function while one call is in progress and reads its statistics. Mechanism: each new call runs stats.clear() on the shared dict and then the copy writes its attempt data into that same dict, so the in-flight call's statistics are reset or mixed with another call's. Previously each call got its own dict, so reads were isolated. Impact: callers reading attempt_number or other statistics from within a retried call get wrong values.
